senses.gloss: f., pl. כּוֹנָנִיּוֹת (כון, cmp. כַּוָּון) [arrangements,] chambers, applied to the entrails arranged above each other.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 56b:13">Ḥull. 56ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>ויכננך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:6">Deut. XXXII, 6</cite>) <he>שברא הקב״ה כ׳ באדם וכ׳</he> the Lord has created carefully arranged chambers in man, one of which being disturbed man cannot live; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 309:7">Sifré Deut. 309</cite> <he>עשאך כנונים כנונים מבפנים וכ׳</he> (prob. to be read <cite ref="K00308"><he>כּוֹנָנִים</he></cite>); (Yalk. ib. 942 <he>בסיסים</he>, v. <cite ref="B00997"><he>בָּסִיס</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="K00828"><he>כֵּן</he> II</cite>).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 547">Yalk. Lev. 547</cite> <cite ref="K00308"><he>כּוֹנָנִין</he></cite> (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <cite ref="S01045"><he>קִינִּין</he></cite>).
